## Verdict

**Kelp** costs least for a team of 12, at **$96 per month**. It is the only vendor whose seat minimum (5) sits below the team size, so the team pays for exactly the 12 seats it uses. Acme Desk bills for 25 seats and Fennel HQ for 50, so both charge for capacity the team will not touch — $350 and $950 per month respectively.

## Vendor pricing

| Vendor | Price per seat | Minimum seats |
|---|---|---|
| Acme Desk | $14 | 25 |
| Fennel HQ | $19 | 50 |
| Kelp | $8 | 5 |

## Cost at this size

Seats paid for = the greater of 12 (team size) or the vendor minimum.

- **Kelp:** minimum 5 < 12, so 12 seats paid. 12 × $8 = **$96 per month**. Effective rate $8.00 per person.
- **Acme Desk:** minimum 25 > 12, so 25 seats paid. 25 × $14 = **$350 per month**. 13 unused seats, worth $182. Effective rate $29.17 per person ($350 ÷ 12).
- **Fennel HQ:** minimum 50 > 12, so 50 seats paid. 50 × $19 = **$950 per month**. 38 unused seats, worth $722. Effective rate $79.17 per person ($950 ÷ 12).

Kelp is $254 per month cheaper than Acme Desk and $854 per month cheaper than Fennel HQ — $3,048 and $10,248 over twelve months.

## Risks

The ranking at this size is driven by seat minimums rather than headline rates, but Kelp's lead does not depend on them. Its $8 per-seat price is the lowest on the list, so it stays cheapest at every headcount above 5. Acme Desk's $350 is fixed until 25 people, at which point its effective rate drops to $14 against Kelp's $200 total — still more expensive. Fennel HQ does not reach its list rate until 50 seats.

This is a price comparison only. The price list carries no information on features, support tiers, usage limits, security posture, or integrations, so a cheaper seat may buy a narrower product. All figures assume list pricing billed monthly as stated; annual commitments, volume discounts, onboarding fees, and migration costs are not in the source and could change these totals. Confirm whether minimums are enforced at signup or only at renewal, and whether a contractual seat floor persists if the team shrinks.
